title: IDApps application descriptor
description: Structural validation for an individual application descriptor.

repository.description: Docker image repository, optionally registry-qualified, without a tag or digest.

tag.description: Image tag used when no digest is specified.

digest.description: Optional SHA-256 image digest; takes precedence over the tag.

base.description: Host directory used as the base: the current working directory or the user home directory.

path.description: Forward-slash-separated path relative to the base; an empty string selects the base itself.

type.description: Identifies this mount as a host directory bind mount.

source.description: Host directory to mount into the container.

target.description: Absolute destination path inside the container.

create.description: Create a missing host directory when permitted; the current working directory cannot be created.

readOnly.description: Mount the host directory without write access when true.

type.description: Identifies this mount as a named Docker volume.

name.description: Name of the Docker volume owned by this service.

target.description: Absolute destination path inside the container.

readOnly.description: Mount the volume without write access when true.

containerPort.description: Port inside the container to receive traffic.

protocol.description: Transport protocol for the port binding.

hostIP.description: Host address on which to publish the port.

linux.description: Use the invoking user identity or the image default on Linux.

windows.description: Use the image default user on Windows.

darwin.description: Use the invoking user identity or the image default on macOS.

kind.description: Identifies the app as a command.

image.description: Container image used to run the app.

entrypoint.description: Literal entrypoint arguments; omit to inherit the image entrypoint or use an empty array to clear it.

args.description: Literal arguments prepended to user arguments; when omitted, user arguments replace the image command, or the image command is inherited if none are supplied.

workdir.description: Absolute working directory inside the container.

environment.description: Literal environment variables passed to the container.

network.description: Docker network mode used by the container.

user.description: Container user policy for each supported host operating system.

mounts.description: Host directories mounted into the command container.

entrypoint.description: Literal entrypoint arguments; omit to inherit the image entrypoint or use an empty array to clear it.

workdir.description: Absolute working directory inside the container.

environment.description: Literal environment variables passed to the container.

network.description: Docker network mode used by the container.

windows.description: Use the image default user on Windows.

darwin.description: Use the image default user on macOS.

user.description: Services use the image default user on every supported host.

mounts.description: Directories or volumes mounted into the container.

containerName.description: Docker container name reserved for this service.

ports.description: Host port bindings for the service; must be empty with host networking.

network.description: Network mode selected for the service.

ports.description: Host networking requires no published port bindings.
